description: Display a claim's stated verification status and supporting source.
documentation_wikitext:
__NOTOC__
Display a claim's stated verification status and supporting source.

== Usage ==
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">
{{Claim status|status=verified|text=Example claim.|source_url=https://example.org/|source_description=Example evidence}}
</syntaxhighlight>

Omit optional parameters that do not apply. The parameter reference below lists supported names and aliases.

examples.description: A verified claim with its source link and description.

implementation.body_wikitext: {{#if:{{{text|}}}|{{{text}}}|Error: claim text required}} {{#switch:{{lc:{{{status|}}}}}|verified={{#if:{{{source_url|}}}|[{{{source_url}}} verified]|verified}}{{#if:{{{source_description|}}}|; source: {{{source_description}}}}}|unverified=unverified|#default=unknown status}}

parameters.description: Verification state stated by the cited source. The template displays this value; it does not establish verification.
parameters.label: Status
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Short description of the supporting source.
parameters.label: Source description
parameters.name: source_description
